newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila export-based firms soar on peso plunge.
newsitem.headline: Manila export-based firms soar on peso plunge.

text.p: Philippine export-based firms Solid Group Inc and Ionics Circuits Inc surged in late Friday trade in reaction to news that the Central Bank allowed the peso to depreciate, brokers said.

"These export-oriented companies whose revenues are highly sensitive to the peso-dollar rate are expected to gain with the Central Bank's decision. The more the peso depreciates, the better for these firms," said Henry Ong, analyst at Sapphire Securities.
Solid Group jumped 90 centavos, or 23.68 percent, to 4.70 pesos in late trade with 12.05 million shares changing hands.
Electronics firm Ionics climbed 2.75 pesos, or 17.19 percent, to 18.75 pesos.
Solid is the sole franchise holder of Sony Corp and Aiwa Co Ltd products.
